property_summary: After a single fallback call with 10 ether at block.number=1 (where 1%15 != 0) the reference (transfer only on %15==0) keeps the balance, while the buggy version (transfer on %15!=0) sends it all, leaving address(c).balance different.
change_summary: Change the modulo condition from `% 15 == 0` to `% 15 != 0` to invert the transfer logic.
